candidates.name: correct
candidates.label: correct
candidates.description: Publishes the layer and queries WFS 2.0 with a CRS-qualified bbox (urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326), getting all 4 zones.

candidates.name: wrong_axis_order
candidates.label: wrong
candidates.description: Passed the bbox as minx,miny,maxx,maxy without a CRS URI. WFS 2.0 / EPSG:4326 expects lat,lon (Y,X) axis order, so the bbox lands in the ocean and returns 0 features.
